name: @natlang/migration
description: Repository migrations in natural language: intent, survey of sites, usage classification, planning, one exact patch per site, failure triage and repair in a loop with a natural-language stopping judgment. The repository service keeps revisions in memory and runs the declared checks in a temporary directory.

migration.description: natlang run applications/migration -- MANIFEST.json [--attempts N] [--seed TEXT]... [--exact|--settled crisp|natural-language]
